title: Icyizere cya mbere cyamenetse muri Paradizo
intro: Tekereza uhagaze mu busitani bw'amahoro atagira inenge, wubashywe kurusha ibiremwa byose, ufite umupaka umwe gusa wo kubaha. Ijwi risesereza ubuziraherezo, amahitamo amwe ahindura byose, nyamara imbabazi zikingura inzira yo gusubira inyuma. Ni nde uvuga kuva mu ntangiriro y'ikiremwamuntu?
clues: Naremwe na Allah mu ibumba kandi naremwe n’ubwitonzi bw’Imana.
Nahawe icyubahiro ubwo Allah yategekaga abamalayika kunyunamira.
Nabanye muri Paradizo n'uwo twashakanye, nta kindi nashoboraga gukora uretse igiti kimwe gusa.
Nashutswe n'amagambo anyomoza ya Satani warahiye kuba umujyanama w'ukuri.
Nariye ku giti cyabujijwe kandi umwenda wanjye wakuweho kubera isoni.
Namenye amagambo yo kwihana aturutse ku Mwami wanjye, maze Allah arangarukira mu mbabazi.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yanze kwinjira mu gihugu cyera kubera ubwoba
Yishe umuvandimwe kubera ishyari kubera igitambo
Nariye ku giti cyabujijwe nyuma y'uko Satani anyomoza
Bavugaga ko ibigirwamana by'abakurambere bigomba gusengwa
trial.answer: Nariye ku giti cyabujijwe nyuma y'uko Satani anyomoza

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Narohamye mu myuzure ikomeye hamwe n'abatizera
Allah yanyigishije amagambo yo kwihana kandi arambabarira
Nakubiswe n'inkuba kubera gusaba kubona Imana
Namizwe n'ifi ikomeye kubera ko navuyeyo n'uburakari
Nahindutse hamwe n'abantu banjye kubera kwica Isabato
outcome.answer: Allah yanyigishije amagambo yo kwihana kandi arambabarira

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
